notes.title: Release Notice 发布通知
notes.content:
The first beta version of Arena of Cube is expected to be released on July 26th. The game modes include BedWar, SkyWar and SnowWar, There are 5 heroes in the game and each hero has professional skills. Chinese version is coming soon.
Our official website is: http://arenaofcube.com/
Follow us: 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/ArenaofCube/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/arenaofcube
Discord: https://discord.gg/xzrCnAc
WhatsApp: https://chat.whatsapp.com/53iHozeSMXnJeoclRJcG2x
Looking forward to your visit!

《小游戏世界》的第一个测试版本预计在7月26日发布，包含起床、空岛和雪球大战三种游戏模式。游戏里有5位英雄，每位英雄都具备专业的技能。（中文版即将推出）
